subject: IntelSecure SOC 2 readiness: IR evidence snapshot & chain-of-custody ask
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <security@intelsecure.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: IntelSecure Legal <legal@intelsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 prep - request for IRP evidence snapshot and log preservation

Michael —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of IntelSecure's SOC 2 readiness checklist we need a short evidence snapshot from Redwood covering incident response capabilities and a small set of telemetry/log samples for our auditors. Specifically we are asking for:

- A current copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) and any recent tabletop/exercise notes
- A manifest of log samples we can accept (time range, blinding/redaction guidance) and approximate size
- Chain-of-custody language for how logs are handed off to third parties/auditors
- A timeline estimate for providing access or deliverables (we're hoping for something within 7 business days)

Can you confirm scope and whether any legal or procurement approvals are required on your end? If it's easier we can accept an encrypted archive link, and our legal team (cc'ed) will confirm the NDA/PO terms.

Appreciate it — we're aiming to close this chunk by Sep 10 for the external audit.

Carlos
Security Engineer
IntelSecure

Attachment: none (initial request)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <security@intelsecure.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, IntelSecure Legal <legal@intelsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 prep - request for IRP evidence snapshot and log preservation

Carlos —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the IRP and a small, sanitized log sample set for audit review. Quick notes on scope so we're aligned: 

- IRP: we'll provide the current IRP (redwood internal class: IRP_v2.1) and a short tabletop summary from our July drill.
- Logs: we can produce a manifest + 24 hours of anonymized request/ingest telemetry for the service boundaries you specify; our default retention extract contains request IDs, timestamps, and anonymized user identifiers.
- Chain of custody: Jonas (cc) will propose a short text we use for evidence handoffs and any transfer controls.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the time window and any fields you'd like redacted?
2) Please confirm whether IntelSecure needs a formal attestation or if the archive + custodial statement is sufficient for auditors.

We'll aim to have the IRP and manifest to you within 3 business days and the sanitized log archive within 7 business days pending your redaction guidance. If legal needs to sign an NDA/PO, loop them in and we'll coordinate with procurement.

I'll follow up once Jonas produces the custodial language.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <security@intelsecure.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, IntelSecure Legal <legal@intelsecure.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 prep - request for IRP evidence snapshot and log preservation

Carlos / team —

Appreciate the list. Attached is a sanitized IRP extract (Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf) that includes our escalation matrix, tabletop cadence, and evidence handling steps. Key points below: 

- Evidence scope: We will produce a manifest (log_sample_manifest.csv) describing the artifacts, hashes, and redaction notes. The actual log export will be delivered as an encrypted tar.gz with SHA256 checksums.
- Redaction: By default we will remove PII fields (email addresses, raw IPs) and replace with salted hashes. If you require different redaction rules, specify fields by name and we will adjust.
- Chain-of-custody: For audit artifacts we provide a custodial_chain_of_custody.txt that lists who exported the artifacts, timestamp, transfer method (S3 presigned link with limited TTL or sFTP), and the receiving party. We log the transfer event in our internal ticketing system and will share the ticket id on delivery.
- Timeline: IRP + manifest: within 48 hours. Sample archive (24 hours of telemetry): within 7 business days after we agree redaction fields. We can accelerate if you need a smaller time slice.

Attachments included: Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf (IRP extract), log_sample_manifest.csv, custodial_chain_of_custody.txt (plain text).

If IntelSecure legal prefers a DocuSign attestation for the chain-of-custody statement we can sign and return — include the link and we'll expedite.

Jonas Weber
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf (application/pdf), log_sample_manifest.csv (text/csv), custodial_chain_of_custody.txt (text/plain)

From: Rachel Li <rachel.li@intelsecure.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <security@intelsecure.com>, IntelSecure Legal <legal@intelsecure.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 prep - request for IRP evidence snapshot and log preservation

Jonas / Michael —

Thanks, this looks good and very actionable. A few quick confirmations from IntelSecure: 

- We'll accept the 24-hour telemetry window but please redact raw IPs and email addresses as you described.
- Please deliver via S3 presigned link with 72-hour TTL and include SHA256 checksums in the manifest.
- Legal is okay with the custodial_chain_of_custody.txt; we will also sign the DocuSign attestation after we receive the files. Link: https://docusign.com/IntelSecure/Envelope-9876

If you can target delivery of the IRP + manifest by end of day Thu (48 hours), we'll get back to you on a specific 24-hour slice for the log export. 

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Rachel Li
Information Security Lead
IntelSecure
